name: RRP Defense Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Euro Asia Exports Ltd does trading and exports of various items[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of trading and dealing in fabrics, garments and other trading material, etc. At present, company is starting the business of selling sponge iron

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 52.7%
Promoter holding has increased by 72.8% over last quarter.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 197 days to 21.0 days
cons: Stock is trading at 86.3 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 363 days.
